Container.Name: Lodestar-worker
Container.Overview: Requires Lodestar v0.6+. A worker adds crawling, metadata fetching and processing capacity to an existing Lodestar and sends the results to it. It keeps no database and no search index and has no web UI. In the main Lodestar, open Settings, then Workers, then Add worker. Copy the address and the one-time token (valid for 15 minutes) into the fields below. The worker only needs to reach the main instance's cluster port (8091/tcp).
Container.Requires: Lodestar v0.6 or newer running as the main instance

Config.Name: DHT (UDP)
Config.Description: DHT traffic. Host port defaults to 6882 so the worker can run beside the main Lodestar container, which uses 6881. Forward this UDP port on your router.

Config.Name: Join address
Config.Description: Cluster address of the main Lodestar, for example https://192.168.1.10:8091.

Config.Name: Join token
Config.Description: One-time token from Settings, Workers, Add worker. It expires after 15 minutes. After joining, the worker keeps its own certificate and the token is not needed again.

Config.Name: State path
Config.Description: Worker certificate and the on-disk spool used while the main instance is unreachable. Use a pool path, not /mnt/user.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the container runs as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the container runs as (100 = users).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for log timestamps, for example Europe/Berlin.

Config.Name: Intensity
Config.Description: How hard the crawler works: low, balanced or aggressive. Balanced opens about 400 metadata connections at once. Aggressive opens about 1000, and some home routers cannot track that many.
